about: AudioPlayer — a clip or an episode, played on the page. A native audio element underneath, with the kit's own controls over it, so every control is a real button or slider a keyboard and a screen read

map.Title: title
map.State: Stopped: runtime, not a prop, Playing: runtime, not a prop

title.about: What it is. Required: it names the player and its play button. Forty characters or fewer reads best.

description.about: A line above the title: the series, the episode, who is speaking. Optional; eighty characters or fewer.

src.about: The audio file. Nothing plays until someone presses play.

duration.about: How long it runs, as it should read before the file has said ("24:05", "1:02:30").

transcript.about: The words, for anyone who would rather read or cannot hear. Shown in a disclosure under the player.

transcriptHref.about: Where the whole transcript can be downloaded.

speeds.about: The speeds the speed button steps through, starting at the first.

skip.about: Seconds the back and forward buttons (and the arrow keys on the position) move.
